name: Early Israelite Yahwism (Iron Age, pre-exilic)

dating.dating_summary: This entity models pre-exilic Iron Age Yahwistic religion as a changing field rather than a single timeless theology; its start is not assigned a fake point date, and later exclusive monotheism is not projected backward onto every early community.

notes: The 'mixed' tag is deliberate: early Israelite religion changed across regions and centuries. This node does not claim that every Israelite group held the same pantheon, cult practice, or degree of exclusivity.
